title: Water potential governs the effector specificity of the transcriptional regulator XylR of Pseudomonas putida.
authors: Dvorak, Pavel; Galvao, Teca Calcagno; Pfluger-Grau, Katharina; Banks, Alice M; de Lorenzo, Victor; Jimenez, Jose I
one_liner_zh: 该文研究水分势对Pseudomonas putida转录调控因子XylR效应物特异性的影响，涉及TF-DNA调控活性，但核心是生理环境对调控功能的影响，而非TF-DNA结合位点预测或互作机制建模，方法上仅用AlphaFold预测结构，缺乏AI/物理模拟的深度互作建模。
abstract: The biodegradative capacity of bacteria in their natural habitats is affected by water availability. In this work, we have examined the activity and effector specificity of the transcriptional regulator XylR of the TOL plasmid pWW0 of Pseudomonas putida mt-2 for biodegradation of m-xylene when external water potential was manipulated with polyethylene glycol PEG8000. By using non-disruptive luxCDEAB reporter technology, we noticed that the promoter activated by XylR (Pu) restricted its activity and the regulator became more effector-specific towards head TOL substrates when cells were grown under water subsaturation. Such a tight specificity brought about by water limitation was relaxed when intracellular osmotic stress was counteracted by the external addition of the compatible solute glycine betaine. With these facts in hand, XylR variants isolated earlier as effector-specificity responders to the non-substrate 1,2,4-trichlorobenzene under high matric stress were re-examined and found to be unaffected by water potential in vivo. All these phenomena could be ultimately explained as the result of water potential-dependent conformational changes in the A domain of XylR and its effector-binding pocket, as suggested by AlphaFold prediction of protein structures. The consequences of this scenario for the evolution of specificities in regulators and the emergence of catabolic pathways are discussed.
abstract_zh: 细菌在其自然栖息环境中的生物降解能力受水分可利用性影响。在本研究中，我们考察了当外部水势通过聚乙二醇PEG8000调控时，恶臭假单胞菌（*Pseudomonas putida*）mt-2的TOL质粒pWW0上的转录调控因子XylR对间二甲苯生物降解的活性及效应物特异性。利用非破坏性luxCDEAB报告技术，我们注意到当细胞在水不饱和条件下生长时，由XylR激活的启动子（Pu）活性受限，且调控因子对TOL底物头部变得更加效应物特异。这种由水分限制引起的紧密特异性，在通过外部添加相容性溶质甘氨酸甜菜碱以抵消细胞内渗透压胁迫时得到缓解。基于这些事实，我们重新检验了早期在高基质胁迫下分离出的、作为对非底物1,2,4-三氯苯的效应物特异性响应者的XylR变体，并发现其体内活性不受水势影响。所有这些现象最终可解释为水势依赖性构象变化的结果，这些变化发生在XylR的A结构域及其效应物结合口袋中，正如AlphaFold对蛋白质结构的预测所提示。本文讨论了这一情景对调控因子特异性进化及分解代谢途径出现的潜在影响。
